WEB_ATTENDANCE.TITLE: Web attendance
WEB_ATTENDANCE.SETTINGS_HELP: Continue support in a web chat hosted by this installation, keeping the same conversation.
WEB_ATTENDANCE.GREETING_HELP: With greetings enabled, send a greeting and invitation once per attendance cycle. A new attendance after resolution requires a new link.
WEB_ATTENDANCE.GREETING_LIMIT_ERROR: The greeting with a web invitation must contain no more than {max} characters on WhatsApp Cloud. Shorten the greeting or disable its web invitation before saving.
WEB_ATTENDANCE.CLOUD_HELP: WhatsApp Cloud greetings, invitations and reminders require the 24-hour messaging window. The button opens the web chat; WhatsApp may use an external browser.
WEB_ATTENDANCE.INVITE_UNAVAILABLE: Invitations and text links cannot be sent now. To reopen the WhatsApp messaging window, use an approved template or wait for a new customer message. Existing web access remains available.
WEB_ATTENDANCE.LIMIT_ERROR: Use up to {invitation} characters in the invitation and {button} in its button label. Check the inbox settings for the button label.
WEB_ATTENDANCE.DEFAULT_CONTENT_HELP: Initial text for manual invitations, editable before sending. Leave blank to use the default. Does not change greetings or automatic reminders.
WEB_ATTENDANCE.DEFAULT_CONTENT: Continue our conversation in the web chat. Click the button below to open it.
WEB_ATTENDANCE.ERROR: Unable to update web attendance. Please try again.
WEB_ATTENDANCE.INACTIVE: Web access has ended. Send a new invitation to continue.
WEB_ATTENDANCE.PRIVACY: Anyone receiving the link can access this attendance's public messages until it ends.
